subject: Dashboard & Retention Credits — proposed split and next steps
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna@acme.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: observability add-on split

Thanks for the walkthrough today — the dashboard UX looked great and the retention/tracing demos helped the engineering team. Attached is a simple SKU sheet (acme_proposed_sku_v3.xlsx) that our finance team drafted as a starting point. Two asks from my side: 

1) Can you confirm whether observability credits can be split at purchase time across "tracing" and "advanced dashboards"? Our internal mandate is to show separate line items for trace ingestion/storage vs. dashboard seats/retention.

2) Procurement asked whether onboarding/setup credits (one-time) can be amortized across the term instead of a lump sum on the first invoice. That would help the PO.

Also attaching a mockup of a dashboard the product team is targeting (dashboard-mockup.png) so you can ensure the retention profile maps to the UI interactions.

Let me know if you need a quick call with procurement.

Cheers,
Jenna
Head of Platform, Acme AI

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@acme.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: observability add-on split

Thanks Jenna — really useful context and the mockup is helpful. Quick answers up front: yes, we can represent observability as two purchasable credit pools (Tracing Credits + Dashboard Retention Credits) on the quote/PO; and we can offer an amortization option for the onboarding credit (typically spread evenly across the contract months).

Proposal (so we have something concrete for procurement):
- Split approach: allocate credits in a 55/45 split (tracing/dashboard) by default with the option to reassign up to 20% within the first 90 days.
- Amortized onboarding: onboarding credit rolled into monthly invoices across the committed term (12 or 24 months).
- Dashboard surcharge: advanced dashboards that use long retention (>90 days) incur a per-active-dashboard surcharge; we can show this as a separate line item or fold into the dashboard credits if you prefer a single line.

If that structure looks acceptable, I can produce a cleaned quote and a redline SOW (I'm attaching a draft SOW for comment). I'd also suggest a 30-day technical pilot where dashboards use 30d retention and tracing uses 90d to validate tail latencies and token consumption.

Next steps:
- Kimberly: can you confirm floor discounting for credits on a committed 12-month $Xk ARR?
- Jenna: is procurement open to a DocuSign with the amortized onboarding language or do they require a separate credit note?

Thanks — I'll wait for Kimberly's note and can spin the DocuSign once we align.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: observability add-on split

Looping in a pricing note — happy to be the signer-off for commercial structure. High level guidance: 

- Pricing floor: for deals in the Acme scale we need to preserve a minimum blended unit price for observability credits; given the product mix Rishi recommended a 55/45 split is a reasonable starting point. That said, we can move to 60/40 dashboard-heavy if they commit to a higher ARR band or take a 24-month term.

- Amortization: we can amortize onboarding across the term (12/24 months) but it reduces our flexibility on billing credits, so we'll require the onboarding scope to be fixed in the SOW (deliverables + acceptance criteria).

- Dashboard surcharge: recommend we present two commercial alternatives to procurement: 
  A) Two-line invoice: Tracing Credits + Dashboard Credits (clean for procurement) 
  B) Single-line invoice: Observability Bundle (includes surcharge applied within internal accounting) — easier operationally for customer finance but less visibility for engineering.

- Concession path: offer a one-time 10% uplift discount on dashboard credits if they sign within 21 days; keep tracing credits at standard discounted tier.

I'll let Rishi draft the final quote. Marissa, FYI in case this touches retention add-ons packaging we discussed last quarter.

Kimberly
Director, Commercial Pricing
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi/Kimberly — procurement is asking for a clean single-line item on the PO (they say it reduces PO rework across our AP system). Would Redwood be willing to accept a single-line Observability SKU that internally splits credits per our agreed percentages? If so, we would only need the breakout for engineering (not on the PO).

On amortization: procurement prefers amortized onboarding but needs language that the onboarding credit will be applied monthly and is non-refundable. Can you include that clause in the SOW? Also, they need a DocuSign link (PO will reference the signed agreement).

On timing: we aim to have a PO in hand by 8/22 if pricing is stable.

--
Jenna

Jenna — thanks, appreciate the clarity from procurement. Confirming commercial path we will put on the DocuSign and quote: 

1) Purchase option: Single-line Observability SKU on PO (we will include an internal credit split 55% Tracing / 45% Dashboard for engineering reporting). If Acme wants the invoice to show a different split, we can adjust but it will change the discounting bands.

2) Onboarding credit: $25,000 one-time credit amortized over 12 months, non-refundable; full onboarding scope included in SOW (attached). Will add explicit language: "Onboarding credit will be applied as a monthly invoice reduction over the Term and is not refundable. Acceptance criteria are defined in Appendix A of the SOW."

3) Dashboard surcharge: advanced dashboards with retention beyond 90 days will be billed at a per-active-dashboard surcharge; for initial term we will waive surcharge for up to 10 dashboards as a pilot concession.

4) Concession: 10% one-time uplift discount on dashboard credits if signed by 8/22/2026. This concession only applies to the first 12 months of the term.
